label: Galaxy navigation and planet scanning
prerequisites: Record executable hash, game version, DLC list and settings from the actual installation.
Use a protected private profile and preparation receipt; confirm selected-save identity through normal Load Game.
Establish a native baseline with the same prepared save before accepting VR behavior.
acquisitionTasks: Investigate Zanethu in Ploitari, Hourglass Nebula as a discovery candidate. Native source maps BioP_N7Crsh to its landing feature and transition 4551 (4419/5679); inspect research/le2-galaxy-fixture-source.md and validate normal reachability and before/after saves before binding or resetting story state.

Acquire a naturally obtained Normandy/galaxy fixture with accessible scanning and an untouched prospect or anomaly. Record planet/system and discovery state privately, without inventing plot IDs or map names.

Inspect actual save values and create hash-pinned recipes with explicit expected credits, minerals, fuel and probes. Include zero, insufficient, exact and surplus values using baseline-measured travel cost.
Record native probe launch cost, scan-hold behavior, mineral gain, travel fuel cost and anomaly unlock through ordinary play before encoding numeric assertions.
Compare normal before/after saves and inspect native discovery/mission dependencies before offering a named unlock/reset recipe. Prefer separate natural saves for untouched and discovered planets.
Define normalized observed state.resources.probes/fuel and discovery/mineral fields with provenance; save values alone do not demonstrate rendered galaxy state.
loadProcedure: Acquire exclusive native-session ownership and use the protected session workflow.
Prepare a private fixture from the pinned base and recipe; retain the save-tool receipt and constrained semantic diff.
Select the staged save through ordinary Load Game; record the selected entry and loading sequence.
Capture observed start state and rendered scene; compare map, player, resources and relevant plot state with expectedStart checks. A map name alone is insufficient.
resetProcedure: Exit the game and collect run-specific logs, observed state, captures and any resulting saves.
Run protected restoration and retain the restoration receipt including newly created files.
For each variant start again from its immutable base and pinned recipe; never reuse a mutated previous run save.

actions.description: Use normal game controls to reach the CIC, enter the galaxy map and select a scannable planet. Sample before and after a legal single launch or the specified refusal, travel or scan-hold case. Record the observed input, probe and resource changes and the rendered outcome.
Open the native galaxy interface on the VR surface and navigate normally, including controlled fuel variants. Do not teleport to bypass travel cost.
Hold/release scanning and deliberately press one probe launch with the actual VR control. Record scan pointer, launch edges and counters; test zero-probe refusal.
For the anomaly case locate and launch normally, observe unlock and enter the discovered mission through normal progression.
Save/reload normally and return to the planet/mission; compare probes, fuel, minerals and discovery state.

assertions.description: Review normal load entry and actual rendered scene, player state and scenario prerequisites against the private fixture acquisition record.
Both eye captures show readable UI and consistent depth; review alongside controller actions and scene video.
Physical headset reviewer records standing and seated reach, visibility, tracking recovery and comfort for this variant.
Verify the protected-session restoration receipt and session log identify restored profiles, config and saves with no unexplained differences.

Check sampled planet identity, probe balance and orbital state. For launch or refusal, sample while scanning before input and again after the scene settles. For scan-hold, sample before the hold and while scanning is held. Use the separate input and scene review to establish what happened between samples.

Review observed costs, mineral yield, travel refusal/success and discovery/mission unlock for this case. For probe cases, compare the orbital samples and reviewed input/scene from one visit to the same rendered planet. Record whether the probe launched or the game refused it and rule out purchases, other launches or travel between samples. A zero delta alone does not establish a refusal or distinguish it from input the game did not receive. Record exact baseline-derived costs and reject duplicate launches.

Video and controller trace show deliberate scanning/probe/travel controls on usable VR UI; one press yields one action and context exit restores gameplay input. Record the matched native baseline run/hash and deliberate gameplay differences.
At the first stable sample after the linked fresh reload and before further travel or purchases, compare all eight resources with the exact archived outcome save.
Review the normal Load Game selection and immediate resource sample, then revisit the rendered planet and check persisted impact and discovery/unlock state and expected mission continuation.
